prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry and how you define “AI” (creative generation, personalization, ad optimization, ML models, analytics, chatbots, etc.). I can recommend firms, but first a few quick questions so I give a useful shortlist:

- What are your primary goals (brand awareness, lead gen, direct response, e‑commerce growth, personalization, automation, CX/chatbots)?
- Rough monthly or project budget?
- Industry or audience (B2B, DTC, healthcare, finance, entertainment)?
- Do you need on‑site/managed services or are remote/outsourced teams fine?
- Timeline and KPIs that matter (CAC, LTV, ROAS, conversion rate)?

If you want a quick way forward, I can either (A) give a tailored shortlist of LA agencies that align with your answers, or (B) give a general short list plus comparison criteria right away. 

Meanwhile, practical guidance to evaluate agencies:

- Core capabilities to check
  - Demonstrable AI use (case studies showing measurable uplift from AI models, personalization, creative optimization, predictive analytics).
  - Data & tech stack (CDP, DMPs, analytics, model infra, partnerships with major cloud/AI vendors).
  - Privacy and compliance (GDPR/CCPA practices, data handling).
  - Cross‑discipline team (data scientists, ML engineers, growth marketers, creatives).
  - Clear KPIs and A/B testing methodology.

- Questions to ask shortlisted agencies
  - Can you show 2–3 case studies with before/after metrics tied specifically to AI work?
  - Which platforms and models do you use? Do you build proprietary models or integrate third‑party tools?
  - How do you handle data ingestion, privacy and security?
  - What does onboarding and reporting look like? How often do you iterate models/campaigns?
  - Who will be on our account team and what’s your escalation path?

- Typical engagement types and budget signals
  - Small pilots: $10k–50k for 6–12 week tests.
  - Mid‑sized programs: $50k–200k+/month for ongoing programmatic personalization or paid media + AI optimization.
  - Enterprise transformation: six‑figure+ retainers for platform builds, CDP integration and custom models.

If you’d like, tell me the answers to the questions above and I’ll produce a 4–6 agency shortlist in LA tailored to your needs (with why each is a fit and sample discovery questions to ask them).
